channelTitle: Grandma June never bought an ice pack, she just opened the freezer
hook: Grandma June never owned a single ice pack, she just grabbed a bag of frozen peas from the freezer instead.
remedy: A bag of frozen peas, soft enough to mold around a knee or ankle, was an old stand-in for a store-bought ice pack, kept in the freezer just for calming a fresh bump, bruise, or twist.
steps: Wrap a bag of frozen peas in a thin towel, never place it straight on bare skin
Hold it against the sore spot for about fifteen to twenty minutes
Let the skin warm back up for a while before icing again if needed, and mark the bag so nobody eats those peas later
caution: Never apply a frozen bag directly to bare skin, it can hurt the skin with prolonged contact. See a doctor for a sprain that's very swollen, won't bear weight, or isn't improving after a couple of days.
cta: Does your freezer have a permanent bag of peas for this too, or do you keep a real ice pack on hand? Tell Grandma June.
